sn47.9:1.2: Ekam samayam Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Beluvagāmake || || 2.
sn47.9:1.4: Etha tumhe bhikkhave samantā Vesāliyā yathā mittaṃ yathā sandiṭṭhaṃ yathā sambhattaṃ vassam upetha gacchatha
sn47.9:1.6: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paṭissutvā samantā Vesāliyā yathā mittam yathā sandiṭṭham yathā sambhattaṃ vassam upagañchuṃ ||
sn47.9:1.7: Bhagavā pana tattheva Beluvagāmake vassam upagañchi || || 3.
sn47.9:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavato vassupagatassa kharo ābādho uppajji || bāḷhā vedanā vattanti māraṇantikā ||
sn47.9:2.2: tatra sudam Bhagavā sato sampajāno adhivāsesi avihaññamāno || || 4.
sn47.9:2.4: Na kho pana me tam paṭirūpaṃ yo ham anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅgham parinibbāyeyyaṃ ||
sn47.9:2.5: yan nūnāham imam ābādham viriyena patipaṇāmetvā jīvitasaṅkhāram adhiṭṭhāya vihareyyanti || ||
sn47.9:2.6: Atha kho Bhagavā tam ābādhaṃ viriyena patipaṇāmetvā jīvitasaṅkhāram adhiṭṭhāya vihāsi || || 5.
sn47.9:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā vihārā nikkhāmitvā vihārapacchā chāyāyam paññatte āsane nisīdi || || 6.
sn47.9:3.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nīsīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn47.9:3.6: api me bhante madhurakajāto viya kāyo || disā pi me na pakkhāyanti || dhammā pi maṃ na paṭibbanti Bhagavato gelāññena || ||
sn47.9:3.7: Api ca me bhante ahosi kācid eva assāsamattā ||
sn47.9:3.8: na tāva Bhagavā parinibbāyissati || na tāva Bhagavā bhikkhusaṅgham ārabbha kiñcid eva udāharatī ti || || 7.
sn47.9:4.1: Kim pana dāni Ānanda bhikkhusaṅgho mayi paccāsiṃsati ||
sn47.9:4.2: desito Ānanda mayā dhammo anantaram abāhiraṃ katvā || ||
sn47.9:4.5: Aham bhikkhusaṅgham pariharissāmīti vā Mamuddesiko bhikkhusaṅgho ti vā so nūnānanda bhikkhusaṅgham ārabbha kiñcid eva udāhareyya || ||
sn47.9:4.6: Tathāgatassa kho Ānanda na evam hoti ||
sn47.9:4.7: Aham bhikkhusaṅgham pariharissamī ti vā Mamuddesiko bhikkhusaṅgho ti vā
sn47.9:4.8: sakim Ānanda Tathāgato bhikkhusaṅgham ārabbha kiñcid eva udāharissati || || 8.
sn47.9:4.9: Etarahi kho panāham Ānanda jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto
sn47.9:4.12: evam eva kho Ānanda vedhamissakena maññe tathāgatassa kāyo yāpeti || || 9.
sn47.9:5.1: Yasmiṃ Ānanda samaye Tathāgato sabbanimittānam amanasikārā ekaccānam vedanānaṃ nirodhā animittam cetosamādhim upasampajja viharati || phāsutaram Ānanda tasmiṃ samaye Tathāgatassa kāyo hoti || ||
sn47.9:5.2: Tasmā ti hānanda attadīpā viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā || ||
sn47.9:6.1: Kathañcānanda bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo || || 10.
sn47.9:6.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.9:6.5: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || ||
sn47.9:6.6: Evaṃ kho Ānanda bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññāsaraṇo dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo || || 11.
sn47.9:6.7: Ye hi keci Ānanda etarahi vā mamaccaye vā attadīpā viharissanti attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā || tamatagge me te Ānanda bhikkhū bhavissanti ye keci sikkhākāmā ti || || 1.
